channel.title: Iristel incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Iristel's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: PSTN Connectivity Issue - Fredericton, New Brunswick [resolved]
item.description:
Dear Iristel Customers,
We are pleased to inform you that the outage has been resolved and services has been restored.
Uptime: Aug. 31, 2026 6PM EDT
For any other concerns and incidents, please do not hesitate to inform us and we will gladly assists you.
Regards, Iristel NOC

item.title: PSTN Connectivity Issue: Val-d'Or, QC [resolved]
item.description:
Dear Iristel Customers,
As confirmed by our service provider, a major outage affected the area due to a failed equipment at their Central Office. The defective equipment has been replaced, and our service provider has confirmed that the issue has been fully resolved and services have been restored.
Thank you for your patience and understanding throughout this incident.
Regards, Iristel NOC

item.title: PSTN Connectivity - Montreal and Quebec city [resolved]
item.description:
Dear Iristel Customers,
The issue has been resolved, and the stability monitoring indicates that the affected network in the region remains stable, with no further instances of downtime detected. All services have been fully restored and have been operating normally since 3:45 PM EDT.
Thank you for your patience and understanding throughout this incident.
Regards, Iristel NOC

item.title: Impact: PSTN connectivity in Iqaluit, Nunavut [resolved]
item.description:
Dear Iristel Customers,
The issue has been resolved and the stability monitoring of the affected media gateway in the region has been positive with no logs of further downtime. All services have been restored to normal operation since 17th July at 07 PM EST.
We would like to thank you for your patience and understanding.
Regards, Iristel NOC

item.title: Service Outage in Yellowknife [resolved]
item.description:
Dear Iristel Customers,
The re-splicing work has been completed, and all affected services have been fully restored as scheduled. We are closing this advisory.
As Iristel operates a redundant network in the region, we did not face any call impact. If you had challenges or continue to see call failures in the region, please contact iristel support team.
We thank you for your patience and understanding.
Sincerely, Iristel NOC

item.title: Connectivity issues in Northern Canada [resolved]
item.description:
Dear Iristel Customers,
We can confirm that all fiber restoration work is now complete and all services have been fully restored.
The initial activity began around 20:00 MT and wrapped up by 23:30 MT. Once finalized, traffic was successfully routed back from our alternate path to the primary fiber route.
Please contact our support teams if you continue to experience any issues with call completion in the region.
Thank you for your patience and cooperation.
Sincerely, Iristel NOC

item.title: Enterprise system - issues with Webex log in. [resolved]
item.description:
Dear Iristel customers,
Please be advised that we faced a temporary issue within our webex platform. This issue was attributed to a transit provider causing a connectivity issue towards our network.
Our network infrastructure team has now blacklisted this transit provider which has resolved our issues with webex connectivity.
If you continue to face challenges with your webex client, please reach out to our support team.
Sincerely, Iristel NOC

item.title: PSTN Outge in New Brunswick [resolved]
item.description:
Dear Iristel Customers,
Please be advised that we have monitored connectivity issue towards New Brunswick which impacted services in the region. During the investigation, all affected services have returned to normal operation. However, we are still awaiting the root cause of the outage from partner carrier.
Rest assured, we will provide further updates as soon as this information becomes available. We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding during this time.
Restoration time - January 17, 2026 05:10:00 PM EST (approximately)
Thank you for your continued support.
Sincerely, Iristel NOC
